title: PediatricsMQA: a Multi-modal Pediatrics Question Answering Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the accuracy of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Augmented LLMs (VLMs) on a newly constructed multi-modal pediatric question-answering benchmark (PediatricsMQA) and comparing their performance disparities across seven distinct developmental stages (prenate, neonate, infant, toddler, preschool, school-age, and adolescent).
